Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_Number;

public class SumOfTwoPrimes {
    static boolean prime(int n) {

        if (n <= 1)
            return false;

        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    static boolean isPrime(int n) {

        if (prime(n) && prime(n - 2)) {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        int n = 19;

        if (isPrime(n)) {
            System.out.println("Yes");
        } else if (isPrime(n)) {
            System.out.println("No");
        }
    }
}
